papers.title: Logarithmic Scores, Power-Law Discoveries: Disentangling Measurement from Coverage in Agent-Based Evaluation
papers.summary: This paper deploys 32 persona-based agent judges to evaluate conversational AI across 960 sessions with two model pairs and 15 tasks. It identifies a score–coverage dissociation: quality scores improve logarithmically with panel size while unique issue discoveries follow a sublinear power law, with scores saturating roughly twice as fast as discoveries. A Turing-style validation shows persona-based agent judges produce evaluations indistinguishable from human raters. The work provides practical guidance on optimal panel sizes for LLM-as-a-Judge deployments.

papers.title: Using LLM-as-a-Judge/Jury to Advance Scalable, Clinically-Validated Safety Evaluations of Model Responses to Users Demonstrating Psychosis
papers.summary: This research develops and validates seven clinician-informed safety criteria for evaluating LLM responses to users demonstrating psychosis. The authors construct a human-consensus dataset and test LLM-as-a-Judge vs. LLM-as-a-Jury automated assessment. Results show LLM-as-a-Judge aligns closely with human consensus (Cohen's κ=0.76), outperforming LLM-as-a-Jury (Cohen's κ=0.71). The work demonstrates that single-model evaluation can be more reliable than ensemble approaches for domain-specific clinical safety evaluation.

papers.title: Single-Agent LLMs Outperform Multi-Agent Systems on Multi-Hop Reasoning Under Equal Thinking Token Budgets
papers.summary: This paper presents an information-theoretic argument grounded in the Data Processing Inequality showing that single-agent LLM systems are more information-efficient than multi-agent systems under fixed reasoning-token budgets. Empirical evaluation across three model families (Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama, and Gemini 2.5) demonstrates that single-agent systems consistently match or outperform multi-agent architectures on multi-hop reasoning tasks when computation is normalized. The findings challenge the prevailing assumption that multi-agent debate and collaboration inherently improves reasoning quality.

papers.title: Agent Q-Mix: Selecting the Right Action for LLM Multi-Agent Systems through Reinforcement Learning
papers.institution: UCLA / University of Washington / Northwestern University
papers.summary: Agent Q-Mix reformulates multi-agent topology selection as a cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) problem using QMIX value factorization. Each agent learns decentralized communication decisions that jointly induce a round-wise communication graph. The framework achieves the highest average accuracy across seven core benchmarks in coding, reasoning, and mathematics while demonstrating superior token efficiency compared to existing multi-agent methods. The approach enables dynamic communication topology rather than fixed agent interaction patterns.

papers.title: YC-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Long-Term Planning and Consistent Execution
papers.summary: YC-Bench evaluates AI agents by tasking them with running a simulated startup over a one-year horizon spanning hundreds of turns, managing employees, selecting task contracts, and maintaining profitability in a partially observable adversarial environment. Roughly one-third of clients are untrustworthy, requiring agents to learn from history. Evaluation of 12 models shows only three consistently surpass starting capital of $200K, with Claude Opus 4.6 achieving the highest average final funds at $1.27M, followed by GLM-5 at $1.21M at 11× lower inference cost.

papers.title: Yet Even Less Is Even Better For Agentic, Reasoning, and Coding LLMs
papers.summary: This paper extends the 'Less-Is-More' hypothesis to agentic scenarios via STITCH (Sliding-memory Trajectory Inference and Task Chunking Heuristic), a coarse-to-fine mechanism that filters low-value noise and retains decision-critical tokens from training trajectories. Models trained with STITCH achieve up to 63.16% relative improvement over base models on SWE-bench Verified. The end-to-end training framework demonstrates that fewer but higher-quality training trajectories yield superior agentic capabilities across coding, reasoning, and tool-use tasks.

papers.title: Adaptive Stopping for Multi-Turn LLM Reasoning
papers.summary: This paper addresses when LLMs relying on multi-turn reasoning (adaptive RAG, ReAct-style agents) should stop iterating. Existing approaches rely on heuristic stopping rules or fixed turn budgets with no formal guarantees. The authors propose an adaptive stopping framework that provides formal guarantees that the final prediction contains the correct answer. This is particularly important for high-stakes domains like finance and healthcare where premature or late stopping leads to incorrect or wasteful outcomes.

papers.title: Asymmetric Actor-Critic for Multi-turn LLM Agents
papers.summary: This paper proposes an asymmetric actor-critic framework for reliable conversational agents where a powerful proprietary LLM acts as the actor while a smaller open-source critic provides runtime supervision. The critic monitors the actor's actions and intervenes within the same interaction trajectory, enabling real-time course correction. The framework decouples generation capability from safety oversight, allowing cost-effective deployment with maintained reliability across multi-turn conversations.

papers.title: Open, Reliable, and Collective: A Community-Driven Framework for Tool-Using AI Agents
papers.institution: University of Notre Dame / Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology
papers.summary: The paper introduces OpenTools, a community-driven toolbox that standardizes tool schemas, provides lightweight plug-and-play wrappers, and evaluates tools with automated test suites and continuous monitoring. The authors argue that agent failures stem from both tool-use accuracy and intrinsic tool accuracy, while most prior work only addresses the former. Community-contributed, higher-quality task-specific tools deliver 6%–22% relative gains over existing toolboxes across multiple agent architectures on downstream benchmarks.

papers.title: Detecting and Correcting Reference Hallucinations in Commercial LLMs and Deep Research Agents
papers.summary: This paper evaluates reference hallucinations across outputs from Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic models including deep research agents (gemini-2.5-pro-deepresearch, openai-deepresearch) and search-augmented LLMs (claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini-2.5-pro, gpt-5.1). The study uses reliable URL liveness data to measure hallucination rates for cited references. The work proposes correction methods to reduce fabricated citations in AI-generated research outputs, addressing a critical reliability concern for LLM deployment in knowledge-intensive tasks.

topnews.source: LM Council / Build Fast with AI

It leads SWE-bench Verified at 78.80%, posts 94.3% on GPQA Diamond, and scores 77.1% on ARC-AGI-2. Benchmark contamination concerns persist, with studies showing model performance can vary by 16% depending on system prompt and tooling configuration.

topnews.source: Microsoft Open Source Blog / Help Net Security

It is the first toolkit to address all 10 OWASP agentic AI risks with deterministic, sub-millisecond policy enforcement. The toolkit provides cryptographic agent identities, runtime isolation, and compliance automation mapped to the EU AI Act, HIPAA, and SOC2. It ships with 9,500+ tests and integrations for LangChain, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Google ADK, Haystack, and Azure, available on GitHub under MIT license in Python, Rust, TypeScript, Go, and .NET.

The release includes four variants: E2B (2.3B), E4B (4.5B), 26B MoE (4B active), and 31B dense. The flagship 31B instruction-tuned model ranks #3 on Arena AI's text leaderboard at 1452 Elo. Gemma 4 supports multimodal inputs (text + image across all sizes, plus audio on edge models), native agentic workflows, and context windows up to 256K tokens, optimized from Raspberry Pi to high-end GPUs.

topnews.summary: Amazon expanded its Health AI agent from One Medical to all U.S. Prime members starting March 11, 2026, providing 24/7 personalized health guidance to over 200 million subscribers. The system uses a multi-agent architecture: a core patient-facing agent, sub-agents for specific workflows, auditor agents reviewing conversations in real time, and sentinel agents monitoring the overall system, with escalation paths to human providers. Eligible Prime members receive up to five free direct-message care consultations covering 30+ common conditions. The agent can interpret lab results, manage prescriptions, and book appointments.

It leads BrowseComp, MCP-Atlas, and tau-squared-Bench for agentic tasks among open-weight models. Released under a permissive license, it can be deployed via vLLM and SGLang.

topnews.title: UniSAFE: First Cross-Modal Safety Benchmark Reveals Critical Gaps in Open-Source Multimodal Models
topnews.summary: UniSAFE introduces the first comprehensive benchmark for system-level safety evaluation of unified multimodal models across 7 input/output modality combinations. The benchmark comprises 6,802 curated instances and evaluates 15 state-of-the-art models, both proprietary and open-source. Results reveal a critical safety gap: open-source models exhibit substantial vulnerabilities, while even proprietary models show elevated failure rates in novel multi-image composition and iterative multi-turn scenarios. The shared-target design enables controlled cross-task comparisons of safety failures.

topnews.title: Trump Administration Releases National AI Policy Framework — Seeks Federal Preemption of State AI Laws
topnews.summary: The Trump administration released its National Policy Framework for AI on March 20, 2026, proposing a federally led regulatory model with significant preemption of state AI laws. The framework spans seven pillars including child protection, IP, censorship, innovation, and workforce. It directs the DOJ to establish a task force to challenge state laws deemed inconsistent with federal policy. However, it carves out three areas from preemption: traditional state police powers, zoning authority over data center siting, and state procurement requirements. States like California (SB 53) and New York (RAISE Act) continue pushing forward with transparency requirements.

topnews.title: Google Unveils TurboQuant: KV Cache Compression Cuts LLM Memory Overhead Dramatically
topnews.summary: Google unveiled TurboQuant, a novel algorithm that significantly reduces the memory overhead of the key-value (KV) cache in large language models. The method uses a two-step process combining PolarQuant vector rotation and the Quantized Johnson-Lindenstrauss compression method. This addresses one of the key bottlenecks in deploying large context-window models at scale, enabling longer contexts and higher throughput on existing hardware. The technique is particularly relevant as models push toward million-token context windows.

WarClaw is designed for tactical decision support and operational planning, reflecting the defense sector's increasing adoption of AI agents for real-time battlefield assistance while maintaining strict data sovereignty.

taiwan.title: Taiwan.md 知識庫：AI 時代用開源協作說台灣故事
taiwan.summary: 新媒體藝術家吳哲宇打造台灣知識庫 Taiwan.md，以開源協作及 AI 友善格式建構最完整的台灣人觀點。知識庫涵蓋文化、歷史、美食、人物、自然等12個面向，目前累計超過百篇文章。計畫旨在讓全球 AI 模型訓練時能納入台灣在地觀點，避免台灣文化在 AI 時代被邊緣化。

taiwan.title: AI 晶片搶產能，台積電帶頭漲價，代工產業進入多頭循環
taiwan.summary: 因 AI 晶片需求持續暴增，台積電與三星等晶圓代工大廠紛紛調漲先進製程報價。台積電 CoWoS 先進封裝產能成為關鍵瓶頸，前置時間僅需6個月。各晶圓廠已向客戶釋出2026年漲價訊息，代工產業正式進入多頭循環。分析師警告晶片通膨恐來襲，但 AI 需求強勁足以支撐漲價。

taiwan.title: AI 需求爆發，台灣晶圓代工業2026年營收上看1700億美元
taiwan.summary: DIGITIMES 分析師預估，台灣晶圓代工產業2026年營收將突破1700億美元，年增率接近30%，創歷史新高。成長動力主要來自 AI 加速器、高效能運算與先進封裝需求。台積電2奈米先進製程進度大幅領先對手，進一步確立未來3至5年的技術壟斷地位。全球 AI 伺服器出貨量超乎市場預期。

taiwan.title: 台美對等貿易協定簽署：半導體成最大贏家，關稅降至15%
taiwan.source: 中央社 CNA / 工商時報
taiwan.summary: 台美於2月13日簽署對等貿易協定（ART），台灣爭取到對等關稅15%不疊加、232條款半導體最惠待遇。2072項輸美產品豁免對等關稅，平均關稅從35.78%降至12.33%。台灣承諾五年內800億美元戰略性採購。半導體被視為最大贏家，即使美國未來對全球半導體課新稅，台灣亦享豁免權。
taiwan.relevance: 直接影響台灣 AI 半導體產業的國際競爭力與出口
taiwan.discussion: 全民與各產業高度關注的重大議題

taiwan.title: INSIDE 硬塞推出《AI Agent：台灣人工智慧新巨浪》專題
taiwan.source: INSIDE 硬塞的網路趨勢觀察
taiwan.summary: INSIDE 硬塞推出 AI Agent 重量級專題，深入訪問立足台灣的各家科技與軟體公司，探討他們如何看待 AI Agent 趨勢。專題涵蓋台灣市場具重大影響力的企業觀點，分析代理式 AI 如何改變台灣企業的營運模式。同時報導黃仁勳談 OpenClaw 為「現代電腦」，標誌 AI 代理應用的新時代。

taiwan.title: AI 用電成長至2030年將破5GW，經濟部：至2034年可穩供
taiwan.summary: 經濟部次長賴建信指出，隨著半導體與 AI 產業鏈擴產，預估至2030年台灣新增用電需求將破5GW，2026到2035年年平均增量為過去10年的2倍以上。他強調預估2034年台灣淨供電能力將增加12.2GW，可確保穩定供電。然而環保團體質疑台灣尚無針對大型資料中心的用電管理辦法。
taiwan.relevance: AI 產業擴張與台灣能源供給的關鍵矛盾
taiwan.discussion: 能源政策與環保社群激辯

taiwan.title: 電力即算力，算力即國力：台灣下一場國力競賽在電網
taiwan.source: INSIDE 硬塞的網路趨勢觀察
taiwan.summary: INSIDE 深度報導指出，台灣的下一場國力競賽不在晶圓廠而在電網。隨著 AI 資料中心用電需求暴增，虛擬電廠（VPP）成為都市能源韌性的解決方案。台積電用電已佔全台8%，加上聯電等廠持續擴產，能源規劃已成為攸關資本市場信任的核心議題。文章探討台灣如何在 AI 算力與電力之間取得平衡。
taiwan.relevance: 台灣 AI 產業發展的能源基礎建設瓶頸
taiwan.discussion: 產業界與政策圈高度關注

taiwan.title: Google Cloud 宣布2026為 Agentic AI 元年，推全端架構助台灣企業轉型
taiwan.summary: Google Cloud 台灣總經理 Mike Chen 宣布2026年為 Agentic AI 大爆發的關鍵元年，推出完整生態系統支持企業轉型。Google Cloud AI 加速日活動展示從 Vertex AI Agent Builder 到企業級部署的全端架構，協助台灣企業築起智慧營運護城河。預估2026年底75%企業將投資代理型 AI。

taiwan.summary: AI 郵報與微軟、零壹科技聯合舉辦「AI Agent 時代：從 GitHub Copilot 到 AI-Native Development」活動，預定4月16日登場。活動介紹 GitHub Copilot、小龍蝦（Lobster）與 Azure 整合應用，探討 AI 原生開發的最新趨勢。AI 郵報創辦人 Davin 同步分享2026年 AI 趨勢與產業觀察。

taiwan.title: 2026企業 AI 應用趨勢：從實驗走向規模化獲利的關鍵
taiwan.summary: 台灣人工智慧網路公司發布2026年企業 AI 導入指南，指出全球超過七成企業已導入 AI，但八成看不到實質 ROI。台灣七成企業停留在「知道 AI 但不知如何行動」階段。報告建議從流程自動化、決策支援切入，強調代理式 AI 為2026年最重要的技術突破，全球市場預估從85億美元成長至2030年350億美元。

taiwan.title: 研華 GTC 亮相：秀機器人大腦 Jetson Thor 平台，搶攻實體 AI 商機
taiwan.summary: 台灣工業電腦大廠研華在 NVIDIA GTC 大會亮相，展示基於 Jetson Thor 平台的「機器人大腦」解決方案，搶攻實體 AI 商機。黃仁勳點名「實體 AI」為下一波重大趨勢，台灣製造鏈積極搶下 AI 機器人的運算核心商機。2025年成立的台灣 AI 機器人產業大聯盟（RIA）已涵蓋超過80家科技與製造業者。
taiwan.relevance: 台灣工業電腦產業切入 AI 機器人的重要佈局

taiwan.title: AI 需求推動半導體營收2026年底前暴增49%，硬體市場上看7000億美元
taiwan.summary: 高盛最新報告預估，AI 需求將推動全球半導體營收在2026年底前暴增49%，AI 硬體市場規模上看7000億美元。美銀分析師預測2026年全球半導體市場將首度突破1兆美元。台灣作為全球半導體製造核心，台積電的先進製程與 CoWoS 封裝產能成為全球 AI 供應鏈最關鍵的環節。

taiwan.title: 是方電訊斥資逾30億，中科打造第四座 AI 資料中心
taiwan.summary: 是方電訊宣布將投資超過30億元在中科園區建置第四座 AI 資料中心（AIDC），預計2026年啟動建置、2028年正式商轉。新機房將支援高密度 AI 運算需求，搭配三環網路連接北部三間 IDC 機房、臺灣西部科技走廊及各大科技園區。是方同步規劃拓展至歐美、日韓、星馬等國際市場。

taiwan.title: ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 三大 AI 2026最新比較：台灣用戶選購建議
taiwan.source: 鏈新聞 ABMedia / 楓羽科技
taiwan.summary: 2026年4月最新評測比較三大 AI 助手：ChatGPT 付費訂閱規模仍最大，但 Claude 年增逾200%、Gemini 年增258%追趕迅速。Gemini 新推無痛匯入 ChatGPT 與 Claude 對話紀錄功能，大幅降低轉換成本。台灣用戶三者均可直接使用且支援繁中，建議策略為一個主力付費、其他免費搭配使用。

china.title: DeepSeek V4 確認將運行於華為昇騰晶片，中國AI算力獨立加速
china.summary: Reuters 4月4日確認 DeepSeek V4 將運行於華為 Ascend 950PR 晶片，為首個基於中國半導體基礎設施的前沿AI模型。DeepSeek 刻意拒絕 NVIDIA 提前取得 V4，將優先窗口獨家給予中國晶片商。阿里巴巴、字節跳動、騰訊已大量訂購華為 Ascend 950PR。V4 採萬億參數 MoE 架構，每次回應僅激活約370億參數，兼顧速度與效能。V4-Lite 已於4月初在 API 節點進行實測，開發者回報推理速度提升30%。該模型預計於4月下旬正式上線。
china.discussion: 🔥極高：全球科技媒體與社群廣泛關注

china.title: 阿里巴巴發布 Qwen3.6-Plus：國產最強編程大模型
china.summary: 阿里巴巴4月2日發布 Qwen3.6-Plus，定位國產最強編程模型。該模型可自主規劃、測試和迭代複雜工程任務，支持百萬 token 上下文窗口，為原生多模態模型，可從截圖和設計稿生成前端網頁代碼。在 SWE-bench 和 Claw-Eval 等權威評測中，性能逼近全球頂尖的 Claude 系列。該模型僅透過阿里雲平台提供，不開源。阿里通義實驗室三日連發三款模型，聚焦 Agent 能力。
china.discussion: 🔥高：量子位、財新、DoNews 等多家媒體報導

china.title: 騰訊將於4月發布混元3.0大模型，WeChat AI Agent 同步推進
china.summary: 騰訊確認將於2026年4月推出混元3.0語言模型，約300億參數，聚焦情境學習與Agent可用性。由前OpenAI研究員、騰訊首席AI科學家姚順宇領導開發。騰訊同步開發微信AI Agent。此前騰訊已將AI Lab併入混元團隊，進行大規模組織整合。混元3.0上線與 DeepSeek V4 同期，標誌中國AI實驗室從跑分競爭轉向實用能力部署。

china.title: 字節跳動 Seedance 2.0 API 開放公測，豆包日均Token破120萬億
china.summary: 火山引擎4月2日宣布 Seedance 2.0 API 面向企業用戶開放公測，該模型採多模態音視頻聯合生成架構，支持文字、圖片、音頻、視頻四種模態輸入，綜合性能跻身全球視頻生成第一梯隊。截至3月，豆包大模型日均Token使用量突破120萬億，三個月內增長一倍，比2024年5月發布時增長1000倍。Seed團隊全球招募百名大模型人才，有機會獲得「豆包股」。
china.discussion: 🔥高：量子位、雷科技、每經網等多家報導

china.title: 高德全量開源具身操作基座模型 ABot-M0
china.summary: 高德地圖4月1日宣布全量開源 ABot-M0，為全球首個基於統一架構的機器人具身操作基座模型，可實現一個「通用大腦」適配多種形態的具身機器人。在 Libero-Plus 基準上任務成功率達80.5%，較業界標杆 Pi0 提升近30%。開源內容涵蓋數據、算法與模型三大維度，包含超600萬條真實操作軌跡的數據集 UniACT。同時推出具身導航基座模型 ABot-N0。
china.discussion: 🔥中高：具身智能領域關注度高

china.title: 阿里雲、百度智能雲同日宣布AI算力漲價，最高34%
china.summary: 阿里雲與百度智能雲3月18日同日宣布AI算力服務漲價，新價格於4月18日起生效。阿里雲平頭哥真武810E等算力卡漲幅5%-34%，文件存儲產品漲30%；百度智能雲AI算力產品上調5%-30%。漲價主因全球AI需求爆發、供應鏈成本上漲。據知情人士透露，另一重要原因是Token調用量暴漲，阿里雲MaaS平台「百煉」1-3月創歷史最高增速。標誌AI產業從補貼階段轉向盈利階段。

china.title: 中國半導體企業營收創歷史新高，SMIC 2025年營收93億美元

china.title: Cursor 承認其 Composer 2 編程模型基於 Moonshot Kimi K2.5
china.summary: TechCrunch報導，AI編程工具 Cursor 承認其新旗艦模型 Composer 2 基於月之暗面的開源模型 Kimi K2.5 構建。事件起因為用戶在代碼中發現 Kimi 標識。Cursor 副總裁表示約1/4計算來自開源基座，其餘來自自有訓練。Moonshot 表示以開放模型生態支持為榮。但此事在中美AI競爭背景下引發爭議，Cursor 聯創承認未在初始博文中提及 Kimi 基座是一個疏失。事件凸顯中國開源模型在全球影響力上升。

china.title: MiniMax港股IPO首日暴漲109%，募資6.19億美元
china.summary: 中國AI獨角獸MiniMax於1月9日在港交所上市，首日股價暴漲109%，收報345港元，市值達1067億港元（約137億美元）。IPO募資48億港元（6.19億美元），散戶認購超1830倍，機構認購36.76倍。MiniMax成立於2021年，由前商湯高管創立，開發文本、音頻、視頻和音樂的大模型，服務超2億用戶、覆蓋200多國，逾70%營收來自海外市場。⚠️該新聞為1月事件，近期仍有持續影響。

china.company: 多家（銀河通用、智平科技等）

china.title: 百度發布文心5.0：超2.4萬億參數，激活比例低於3%
china.summary: 百度於2026年1月發布通用模型 Ernie 5.0（文心5.0），總參數規模超過2.4萬億，激活參數比例低於3%，採用超大規模MoE架構。上線後穩定於LMSYS競技場前20名。百度AI經過十五年布局迎來重估時刻，文心5.0被視為百度AI戰略的關鍵里程碑。模型聚焦推理能力與多模態理解的提升。⚠️該新聞為1月發布，近期持續有後續影響。

china.title: Moonshot AI Kimi K2.5 成為中國最強開源模型，挑戰全球頂尖系統
china.summary: 月之暗面1月27日發布 Kimi K2.5，基於約15萬億混合視覺文本token持續預訓練，為原生多模態Agent模型。具備Agent Swarm模式，可調度最多100個子Agent平行處理問題。在BrowseComp上超越GPT-5.2 Pro，在WideSearch上超越Claude Opus 4.5。截至3月，Kimi K2.5為中國最強AI模型。Cursor基於其構建Composer 2更驗證了其技術實力。⚠️該新聞為1月發布，4月仍有持續影響和討論。

usa.title: Anthropic MCP Crosses 97 Million Installs, Becomes De Facto AI Agent Integration Standard
usa.summary: Anthropic's Model Context Protocol hit 97 million monthly SDK downloads in March 2026, up from ~2 million at launch in November 2024 — a 4,750% growth rate in 16 months. The MCP server ecosystem grew to 5,800+ community and enterprise servers. Every major AI provider now ships MCP-compatible tooling, including Claude, GPT-5.4, and Gemini. The Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation now oversees MCP with backing from OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, AWS, and Cloudflare.

5,800+ MCP servers covering databases, CRMs, cloud, productivity tools

usa.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5.4 featuring a 1-million-token context window (up from 400K in GPT-5.3) and native computer-use capabilities. The model scores 75% on the OSWorld-V benchmark simulating real desktop productivity tasks. It is the first general-purpose model with state-of-the-art computer-use built in, enabling agents to operate computers and execute multi-step workflows across applications. Available in Pro and Thinking versions at $2.50/MTok input.

usa.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 3.1 Pro with upgraded core intelligence, 1M token context window, and agentic improvements in finance and spreadsheet applications. Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite launched as Google's most cost-efficient model at $0.25/1M input tokens. Flash-Lite is faster than Gemini 2.5 Flash with expanded thinking support. usa.summary: Anthropic confirmed the existence of Claude Mythos (codename Capybara), described as 'by far the most powerful AI model we've ever developed' after an accidental leak exposed internal documents. usa.title: AWS Shares Real-World Lessons on Evaluating AI Agents in Production
usa.summary: Amazon Web Services published detailed guidance on evaluating AI agents in production systems, drawing from internal experience building agentic systems at Amazon. The blog covers challenges unique to agent evaluation: multiple LLM calls, tool use, state maintenance across turns, and emergent behaviors. AWS advocates measuring tool correctness, task completion, and reasoning quality across entire workflows rather than just final outputs. The post reflects growing industry consensus that agent evaluation requires fundamentally different approaches than traditional LLM benchmarking.
highlights: Agents break traditional evaluation: multi-step, tool-using, stateful systems
Recommends evaluating tool correctness, task completion, reasoning quality holistically
Draws from internal Amazon agentic system deployments
Industry shift from output-only to workflow-level evaluation

usa.title: LangChain State of Agent Engineering: 57% Now Running Agents in Production
usa.summary: LangChain's 2026 State of Agent Engineering report reveals that 57.3% of respondents now have AI agents running in production, up from 51% in 2025. The survey shows clear growth in production deployment of agentic AI systems. Agent evaluation remains the most challenging frontier, with emergent multi-step behaviors difficult to predict and test. The industry is shifting from building larger language models toward making agents more reliable and deployable in enterprise settings.

Agent evaluation identified as most challenging frontier
Multi-step workflows break traditional evaluation approaches
Industry shifting from model scale to agent reliability

usa.title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent LLM Framework Achieves 77% on Biomedical Data Tasks
usa.summary: Researchers published BioMedAgent, a self-evolving LLM multi-agent framework that learns to use various bioinformatics tools and chain them into executable workflows for autonomous biomedical data tasks. Evaluated on the newly released BioMed-AQA benchmark (327 tasks), BioMedAgent achieved a 77% success rate, surpassing other LLM agents. The framework demonstrates that multi-agent systems with tool-aware capabilities can autonomously carry out complex, domain-specific data analysis pipelines.
highlights: 77% success rate on 327-task BioMed-AQA benchmark
Self-evolving agents that learn to chain bioinformatics tools
Outperforms other LLM agents on biomedical data tasks
Demonstrates autonomous complex data analysis via multi-agent collaboration

usa.title: AI Enforcement Accelerates as Federal Policy Stalls and States Step In
usa.summary: Despite significant executive and congressional attention, no comprehensive federal AI statute has been enacted as of April 2026. In the absence of federal preemption, states have moved to fill the void with AI-specific statutes, expanded use of existing consumer protection and antitrust laws, and attorney general investigations coupled with multistate actions. The enforcement gap between federal policy ambitions and actual legislation is creating uncertainty for AI companies operating across state lines.
highlights: No comprehensive federal AI statute enacted despite White House framework
States filling void with AI-specific statutes and AG investigations
Three-pronged state approach: new laws, existing law expansion, multistate actions
Growing enforcement uncertainty for AI companies across jurisdictions

Rubin delivers up to 10x lower cost per token than Blackwell when inferencing MoE models. Major cloud providers including AWS, Microsoft, and Google have committed to deploying Rubin-based superfactories in H2 2026. Adoption is expected from leading AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, xAI) and cloud providers, marking the industry's transition to next-generation AI compute infrastructure.

usa.summary: xAI completed a $20 billion Series E round, exceeding its initial $15 billion target, with backing from NVIDIA, Cisco, and Qatar Investment Authority. The funds will fuel expansion of the Colossus supercomputer cluster and development of Grok 5. xAI also released Grok 4.20, which scored highest among all March frontier model releases on benchmarks measuring accuracy on news and events published within the prior 30 days, addressing the factuality gap that plagued earlier versions.

usa.title: Pew Research: 76% of Americans Don't Trust AI Despite Rising Adoption
usa.summary: A survey of nearly 1,400 Americans reveals a striking trust-adoption paradox: 76% say they trust AI rarely or only sometimes, while only 27% have never used AI tools (down from 33% in April 2025). Only 6% were 'very excited' about AI while 62% were not excited. 55% say AI will do more harm than good in daily life. Two-thirds say businesses aren't transparent enough about AI use, and the same proportion says the government isn't doing enough to regulate AI. 70% fear AI will eliminate jobs.

usa.summary: Ernst & Young's survey reveals that autonomous AI adoption is surging at technology companies, but governance and oversight frameworks are failing to keep pace. The survey highlights a growing gap between the speed of agent deployment and the maturity of controls designed to manage autonomous AI systems. Companies are deploying AI agents for increasingly complex tasks while internal audit, compliance, and risk management functions struggle to adapt their frameworks.

usa.title: Stanford HAI: AI Agents Shift Knowledge Work from Implementation to Supervision
usa.summary: Stanford HAI held an event exploring how AI agents influence knowledge work, finding that agents shift worker effort from implementation to supervision. The research indicates this shift especially benefits verifiable work and expert workers. Stanford faculty across computer science, medicine, law, and economics converge on a striking theme: the era of AI evangelism is giving way to an era of AI evaluation, with standardized benchmarks needed for legal reasoning, labor displacement tracking, and clinical AI vetting.
highlights: AI agents shift workers from implementation to supervision roles
Shift especially benefits verifiable work and expert workers
Stanford declares 2026 the 'year of AI evaluation' over hype
Standardized benchmarks needed for legal, medical, and labor AI

governance.title: 金管會推動金融專用大語言模型 FinLLM，預計 2026 年底上線
governance.summary: 金管會正全力打造金融 AI 生態系，啟動以銀行知識為核心的「金融專用大語言模型（FinLLM）」，預計 2026 年底上線。首階段聚焦銀行業知識應用，第二階段將擴展至證券、期貨、投信及保險業，建構跨業 AI 生態網。金管會主委彭金隆表示 2026 年台灣將擁有專為金融應用打造的本土 AI，具大學畢業水準，能協助處理大量基礎需求。同步推動的金融科技創投基金首輪 30 億元將在 2026 年首季完成募資。
highlights: 金融專用大語言模型 FinLLM 預計 2026 年底上線
首階段聚焦銀行業，二階段擴展至證券、保險等跨業應用
金融科技創投基金首輪募資 30 億元
目標建構具大學畢業水準的金融專用 AI

governance.title: 台灣 AI 基本法三讀通過，全球第二部國家級 AI 法
governance.summary: 立法院於 2025 年 12 月 23 日三讀通過人工智慧基本法，明定國科會為中央主管機關，行政院成立國家 AI 戰略特別委員會。此法為繼歐盟 AI Act 後全球第二部國家級 AI 法，確立七大基本原則：永續發展、人類自主、隱私保護及資料治理、資安與安全、透明與可解釋、公平不歧視、問責。數位發展部將負責制定風險分類框架，各主管機關依框架制定業務風險分類和規範。⚠️ 日期為三讀日期，後續子法仍在研擬中。
highlights: 全球第二部國家級 AI 法（僅次於歐盟 AI Act）
國科會為中央主管機關，行政院成立 AI 戰略特別委員會
確立七大原則：永續、人類自主、隱私、資安、透明、公平、問責
數位發展部負責制定風險分類框架
後續子法與配套措施仍在研擬中

governance.title: EU AI Act 全面適用倒數：2026 年 8 月合規大限與標準延遲
governance.summary: 歐盟 AI Act 將於 2026 年 8 月 2 日全面適用，但歐洲標準化機構 CEN 和 CENELEC 的協調技術標準制定面臨延遲，時間線推遲至 2026 年底。透明度規則將於 2026 年 8 月生效，高風險 AI 系統須符合記錄保存與可追溯性要求。違規罰款從全球營業額的 1.5% 到 7% 不等。美國川普政府曾於 2025 年施壓歐盟放棄 AI 實務守則，但歐盟仍於 2025 年 7 月發布包含版權保護與透明度要求的實務守則。
highlights: 2026 年 8 月 2 日 EU AI Act 全面適用
CEN/CENELEC 技術標準延遲至 2026 年底
違規罰款最高達全球營業額 7%
美國施壓歐盟放棄 AI 實務守則未果

governance.title: NIST 發布 AI 標準評估方法與 Cyber AI Profile 草案
governance.summary: NIST 於 2026 年 1 月發布《AI 標準開發評估可能方法》（GCR-26-069），並於 3 月 6 日舉辦國際 AI 標準研討會。同時 NIST IR 8596 網路安全框架 AI 概要（Cyber AI Profile）草案已完成 45 天公眾意見徵集，預計 2026 年內發布初版公開草案。該框架圍繞三大焦點：安全（Secure）、防禦（Defend）、遏阻（Thwart），以 CSF 2.0 為基礎擴展至 AI 特有的網路安全風險與機會，並與 AI RMF 互補。
highlights: NIST GCR-26-069 評估 AI 標準開發方法
Cyber AI Profile (IR 8596) 草案預計 2026 年發布初版
三大焦點：Secure、Defend、Thwart
與 CSF 2.0 和 AI RMF 互補整合

governance.title: 基礎模型強、安全框架弱：30 個 AI 代理僅 25 個未公開安全測試細節
governance.summary: 科技新報報導一項針對 30 個主要 AI 代理平台的安全透明度調查，發現 25 個代理未公開任何安全測試細節。僅 15 個非中國代理提及安全框架，10 個完全沒有安全框架文件；中國代理表現更差，僅 1 個擁有安全框架。Cisco 2026 年報告指出 83% 組織計畫部署 AI 代理，但僅 29% 感到安全準備就緒。報導強調 AI 代理的安全與治理缺口正加劇潛在威脅。
highlights: 30 個 AI 代理中 25 個未公開安全測試細節
83% 組織計畫部署 AI 代理，僅 29% 安全準備就緒
非中國代理僅 15/25 提及安全框架
AI 代理安全透明度嚴重不足

governance.title: 微軟示警：AI Agent 爆量上線、治理卻跟不上
governance.summary: 微軟發布警告，隨著生成式 AI 從工具走向代理人（AI agent），企業導入速度大幅提升，但資安與治理缺口同步擴大。超過 80% 的《財富》500 強企業已透過低程式碼/零程式碼工具部署活躍中的 AI agents。微軟指出若缺乏可觀測性、治理與安全控管，agent 可能變成被濫用的「雙面間諜」，帶來資料外洩、營運中斷與合規風險。企業需建立完整的 AI 代理治理框架。
highlights: 80%+ 財富 500 強已部署活躍 AI agents
治理缺口可能使 agent 變成「雙面間諜」
缺乏可觀測性、治理與安全控管為最大風險
企業需建立完整 AI 代理治理框架

governance.title: 金管會推動金融科技有成，建構公平包容的金融科技生態環境
governance.summary: 金管會發布金融科技推動成果報告，強調在 AI 應用治理、監理沙盒、開放銀行等方面的進展。報告指出金管會持續推動金融業運用 AI 指引的落實，確保金融業者遵循六項核心原則：建立治理及問責機制、重視公平性及以人為本的價值觀、保護隱私及客戶權益、確保系統穩健性與安全性、落實透明性與可解釋性，以及促進永續發展。目標實現更包容、公平及國際化的金融科技生態環境。
highlights: 金融業 AI 指引六項核心原則持續落實
推動監理沙盒與開放銀行政策
強調治理問責、公平性、隱私保護
建構包容公平的金融科技生態環境

governance.title: 數位發展部 AI 領航推動計畫：五大政策工具加速企業 AI 導入
governance.summary: 數位發展部持續推動 AI 領航推動計畫，透過算力、資料、人才、行銷、資金五大政策工具協助企業加速 AI 導入。截至 2026 年已協助 242 家次資服業者開發 266 項 AI 模型與服務，其中 80 家業者達產品化，涵蓋醫療照護、防災、金融、製造、零售、教育及公益等領域。計畫執行至 114 年（2025 年）底止，執行經驗將作為政府未來制定 AI 政策的重要參考。⚠️ 日期為近期更新時間，非確切發布日。
highlights: 五大政策工具：算力、資料、人才、行銷、資金
協助 242 家業者開發 266 項 AI 模型與服務
80 家業者達產品化
涵蓋醫療、防災、金融、製造等多元領域

governance.title: 資策會公布 2026 年十大 AI 關鍵技術：AI 從虛擬躍入實體
governance.summary: 資策會公布 2026 年十大 AI 關鍵技術預測，指出 AI 正從虛擬世界躍入實體，成為驅動軟體技術的主角。預測涵蓋 Agentic AI、具身智能、AI 安全治理等方向。2026 年企業將開始推動可重複、嚴謹的負責任 AI（RAI），透過科技治理工具推動 RAI，包括自動化紅隊測試、深偽檢測、AI 庫存管理等。報告強調治理與安全框架需與 AI 代理化趨勢同步發展。
highlights: AI 從虛擬躍入實體世界為 2026 年關鍵趨勢
Agentic AI 與具身智能列入十大關鍵技術
企業推動可重複的負責任 AI（RAI）框架
自動化紅隊測試與深偽檢測為治理新工具
